system_overview: A model-checking configuration module for the reachability test module. It extends the test framework and provides concrete definitions for running the reachability lemma tests, including a configurable number of randomly generated graphs and a bounded sequence override.
actors_and_components: No active actors. This module configures how the reachability lemma tests are instantiated with random graph structures for model-checker-based validation.
state_variables: No state variables. This is a constant-level configuration module.
safety_properties: An assumption asserts that all four reachability lemmas evaluate to true for the generated test cases. If any lemma fails, the specification itself is violated.
model_bounds: A configurable number of randomly generated successor functions (specified by a constant parameter). Sequences are bounded to length at most equal to the number of nodes.
additional_assumptions: The module uses the random graph generation facility from the parent test module. The number of random graphs to test is provided as a model constant. The bounded sequence override is necessary for evaluating the reachability operators, which internally quantify over paths represented as sequences.
